headline: Pakistan Stock Exchange drops over 900 points in early trading
summary: The benchmark KSE-100 index shed 913.14 points, or 0.51%, to 176,604.59 in early trade, driven down by widespread selling in banking, cement, and energy exploration shares.
why: The KSE-100 represents the premier equity benchmark in Pakistan, reflecting domestic liquidity conditions and economic sentiment.

impacts.name: KSE-100 Index
impacts.why: Broad selling across cement, banking, and energy stocks pulled the index down over 900 points.
